Definition: Jocha, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Joha is named twice in the Bible, and the passages here are 1 Chronicles 8:16; 1 Chronicles 11:45. In 1 Chronicles 8:16 we read, "And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;". The same name belongs to more than one man, and 1 Chronicles 11:45 names another of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Joha stands in the record, and I am glad God kept it there. A name like this one reminds me that God forgets no one.
RelatedPeople: Joha, Brother of Jediael; Joha, Son of Beriah
